audit_logs_entity_check.name: audit_logs_entity_check
audit_logs_entity_check.value: length(trim("audit_logs"."entity_type")) between 1 and 64 and length(trim("audit_logs"."entity_id")) between 1 and 128

audit_logs_actor_identity_check.name: audit_logs_actor_identity_check
audit_logs_actor_identity_check.value: ("audit_logs"."actor_type" = 'access_admin' and "audit_logs"."actor_email" is not null and length(trim("audit_logs"."actor_email")) between 3 and 320) or ("audit_logs"."actor_type" <> 'access_admin' and "audit_logs"."actor_email" is null)

bible_translations_permission_window_che.name: bible_translations_permission_window_check
bible_translations_permission_window_che.value: "bible_translations"."permission_expires_at" is null or "bible_translations"."permission_starts_at" is null or "bible_translations"."permission_expires_at" > "bible_translations"."permission_starts_at"

moderation_actions_reason_check.name: moderation_actions_reason_check
moderation_actions_reason_check.value: length(trim("moderation_actions"."reason")) between 2 and 500 and instr("moderation_actions"."reason", char(10)) = 0 and instr("moderation_actions"."reason", char(13)) = 0

quiz_sets_publish_window_check.name: quiz_sets_publish_window_check
quiz_sets_publish_window_check.value: "quiz_sets"."status" not in ('published', 'archived') or ("quiz_sets"."opens_at" is not null and "quiz_sets"."closes_at" is not null and "quiz_sets"."closes_at" > "quiz_sets"."opens_at")

sermon_transcripts_confirmed_fields_chec.name: sermon_transcripts_confirmed_fields_check
sermon_transcripts_confirmed_fields_chec.value: "sermon_transcripts"."status" <> 'confirmed' or ("sermon_transcripts"."confirmed_text" is not null and "sermon_transcripts"."confirmed_sha256" is not null and "sermon_transcripts"."confirmed_at" is not null)

submissions_idempotency_key_check.name: submissions_idempotency_key_check
submissions_idempotency_key_check.value: length("submissions"."idempotency_key") = 36 and "submissions"."idempotency_key" = lower("submissions"."idempotency_key") and "submissions"."idempotency_key" glob '????????-????-7???-[89ab]???-????????????' and "submissions"."idempotency_key" not glob '*[^0-9a-f-]*'

submissions_correctness_mask_check.name: submissions_correctness_mask_check
submissions_correctness_mask_check.value: length("submissions"."correctness_mask") = "submissions"."total_cells" and "submissions"."correctness_mask" not glob '*[^01]*' and length("submissions"."correctness_mask") - length(replace("submissions"."correctness_mask", '1', '')) = "submissions"."correct_cells"

submissions_content_status_check.name: submissions_content_status_check
submissions_content_status_check.value: ("submissions"."status" = 'visible' and "submissions"."display_name" is not null and "submissions"."answers_json" is not null and "submissions"."hidden_at" is null and "submissions"."deleted_at" is null) or ("submissions"."status" = 'hidden' and "submissions"."display_name" is not null and "submissions"."answers_json" is not null and "submissions"."hidden_at" is not null and "submissions"."deleted_at" is null) or ("submissions"."status" = 'deleted' and "submissions"."display_name" is null and "submissions"."comment" is null and "submissions"."answers_json" is null and "submissions"."deleted_at" is not null)
